keyword: how often to post on social media for small business
angle: A data-backed posting cadence playbook for small businesses, with platform-specific frequencies tied to real 2025-2026 engagement and reach lift studies.
secondary_kw: social media posting frequency for small business

stats.claim: LinkedIn accounts posting 11+ times per week earn nearly 17,000 more impressions per post and 3x more engagements than accounts posting once weekly
Instagram accounts posting 10+ times weekly see +0.66% follower growth versus only +0.12% for accounts posting 1-2 times weekly
Buffer analysis of 100,000+ users found consistent posting drives 5x more engagement than irregular posting
43% of small business owners spend about 6 hours per week on social media marketing
Hootsuite recommends 3-5x/week Instagram, 1-2x/day Facebook & LinkedIn, 2-3x/day X
Short-form video delivers 71% higher ROI than other content formats
